- Procurement / PO: Matthew Reed (procurement contact) — Claire to introduce

- Security questionnaire returned: 3–5 business days to initial answers, evidence delivery to follow

Ben / Markus / Neha — can you review the sequencing above? Claire / Tom — if the owner map looks accurate, can you introduce Matthew (procurement) and the Navisys legal contact and confirm any blackout dates in November?

- Use DocuSign for NDA and the commercial sheet to get signatures on the PO quickly.
